name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt install -y <packages.txt; [ -f requirements.txt ] && pip3 install --user -r requirements.txt; [ -f webapp_flask/requirements.txt ] && pip3 install --user -r webapp_flask/requirements.txt; echo '✅ Packages installed and Requirements met'
